title: daphne odora f. marginata
intro: Daphne odora f. marginata, commonly known as the variegated winter daphne, is a fragrant, evergreen shrub with showy, pinkish-white flowers. This plant is prized for its delicate, pink-edged leaves and its ability to repel pests and attract pollinators. The health benefits of Daphne odora f. marginata include its use in traditional medicine to treat digestive issues and relieve stress, thanks to its therapeutic actions as an antispasmodic and antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include daphnin, a toxic alkaloid, and borneol, a compound with anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic uses.
